official_definition: Great Twinkle Navigation (When Advents) You can put as many of your Nexuses as you want beneath your Spirits that have "Advent." When you've done so, for each Nexus, destroy an opposing Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Great Twinkle Navigation] or [Great Twinkle Navigation: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Great Twinkle Navigation]", "give [Great Twinkle Navigation]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
